description: This file defines the `FixedDepositProduct` class, a domain model representing a fixed deposit product within a savings or deposit management system. It extends `SavingsProduct`, encapsulating properties such as interest rate charts, deposit terms, and pre-closure options, along with methods for updating, validation, and chart management.

classes.name: FixedDepositProduct
classes.description: Represents a fixed deposit product with interest rate charts, terms, and pre-closure options, extending the SavingsProduct class.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new FixedDepositProduct with specified parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the current fixed deposit product based on a JsonCommand input, including validation and chart updates.

methods.name: findChart
methods.description: Finds and returns an InterestRateChart by its ID within the product's charts.

methods.name: applicableChart
methods.description: Finds and returns the applicable interest rate chart for a specific date.

methods.name: depositProductTermAndPreClosure
methods.description: Returns the deposit product term and pre-closure details.
